assumptions.coverage: Price coverage divides fully priced modeled awarded MWh by modeled awarded MWh. Award-node evidence requires both node/hour endpoints in actual market PTP awards; it is not actual awards to this strategy or exact directed-pair award coverage.
assumptions.deenergized_lists: Original operating-day lists unavailable. Existing in-money/no-awards restriction reconstructed from market bids and awards for auction outcomes only, not that day's order selection.
assumptions.grid: Same grid-score formula, causally refitted from archives beginning 2018; no modern topology peer map; unavailable node fits retain the existing zero fallback.
assumptions.nodes: Then-observed price universe and the latest 30 DAM disclosures published before D-1 09:55 America/Chicago; fixed logical-node exclusions.
assumptions.prices: First-published vintages for decisions and original DA clearing for awards. Final corrections affect settlement, never earlier decisions. Correction search ends 181 days after each event start.
assumptions.settlement: Strict DA sink-minus-source spread < bid. P&L = MWh times (RT spread minus DA settlement spread). Four paired 15-minute RT intervals required; missing payouts are not zero.
assumptions.sizing: Cold start at the frozen risk prior at each event start; D-2 reference updates within the event. Not a continuous pre-storm sizing history.

cost_basis: before costs; no market-impact model; current published quantities
evidence_basis: retrospective diagnostic; not executed trades or independent validation
